layout.arrangement: Single centered title slide: thin red rectangular border frames the entire slide inset ~4-5% from all edges; a small yellow oval slide-number badge sits in the top-right corner inside the border; the title block (title, subtitle, date) is horizontally centered and vertically centered slightly above middle; a small pen-cursor icon sits just below the date near center; a solid black horizontal strip runs along the very bottom edge of the frame, outside/below the red border.

regions.name: Red border frame
regions.position: full slide, inset ~4% from top/left/right, ~5% from bottom (roughly 4%-96% vertical, 5%-95% horizontal)
regions.content: Thin dark-red rectangular outline enclosing all slide content; interior fill is very light gray/off-white

regions.name: Slide number badge
regions.content: Small yellow ellipse with purple outline containing the number '2' in dark text

regions.name: Title block
regions.content: Three stacked centered lines in red: 'Transformers' (largest), 'Part II' (medium), 'Aug. 2020' (small, italic)

regions.name: Pen cursor icon
regions.content: Small dark pen/stylus pointer icon (presenter's annotation cursor captured in the video)

regions.name: Bottom black strip
regions.content: Solid black horizontal bar spanning the full slide width (video letterbox/player strip)

layout.hierarchy: 'Transformers' dominates visually (largest, heaviest weight, bright red); 'Part II' is second (roughly half the title's size, bold red); 'Aug. 2020' is smallest (bold italic red); the yellow slide-number badge and red border are small accents; the black bottom strip is low-contrast framing.

visual_elements.description: Thin rectangular border framing the whole slide content area, uniform stroke width (~2px), no fill of its own; interior background is very light gray.
Slide-number badge: small horizontal ellipse filled pale yellow with a purple/violet outline, containing the numeral '2' in small dark text, centered in the ellipse.
visual_elements.position: top-right corner, inside the red border

visual_elements.description: Solid black horizontal bar/strip across the entire bottom edge of the frame, below the red border (video player/letterbox strip).
Small pen/stylus cursor icon (dark gray/black outline of a handheld pen angled diagonally), appearing as the presenter's annotation pointer frozen on the slide.
visual_elements.position: just below the date line, slightly left of horizontal center

imagery: Small pen/stylus pointer icon (annotation-tool cursor) rendered in dark gray outline, located just below the 'Aug. 2020' text near center; no photographs or illustrations otherwise.
typography_notes: All text is sans-serif (Arial/Calibri-like). Title 'Transformers' is very large (~54-60pt equivalent), extra-bold, red. 'Part II' is bold, roughly 55-60% of title size, red. 'Aug. 2020' is bold italic, roughly 30-35% of title size, red. Everything is center-aligned with tight vertical stacking. Slide number '2' is small, regular weight, dark gray/black. No all-caps styling; title uses title case as written.
animation_state: Static title slide; no build in progress. The only transient artifact is the presenter's pen-cursor icon frozen below the date line.
recreation_brief: 1. Create a 16:9 slide with a very light gray background (#F5F5F5). 2. Draw a rectangle with no fill and a ~2pt dark-red (#C00000) outline, inset about 4-5% from all slide edges, to form the border frame. 3. In the top-right corner (inside the border), insert a small oval shape (~0.5in wide) filled pale yellow (#FFFF99) with a 1.5pt purple (#6633CC) outline; type '2' inside it in small dark-gray text, centered. 4. Centered horizontally at ~35% slide height, add a text box with 'Transformers' in bold sans-serif (e.g., Arial Bold), ~54-60pt, color #C00000. 5. Directly below, centered, add 'Part II' in the same bold red sans-serif at ~32-36pt. 6. Directly below that, centered, add 'Aug. 2020' in bold italic red sans-serif at ~18-20pt. 7. Optionally add a small pen/stylus icon (Insert > Icons or a freeform pen shape, dark gray #333333) just below the date, slightly left of center, to mimic the captured cursor. 8. At the very bottom of the slide, add a full-width solid black (#000000) rectangle ~5% of slide height tall, overlapping/below the red border, to reproduce the bottom strip. 9. Ensure all three text lines are center-aligned as one visually stacked block with small line spacing between them.
